[[Korg's Recurve Bow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by [[Beastmaster Korg]], a [[boss]] in [[Rragar's Menagerie]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Dazed]] duration on foes by 33%
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a [[Turtle Shell Longbow]], but it is a light green color.
